model.title: Mental Health in Aviation Act of 2025
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. John Hoeven (R-ND)

summary.text: The bill would require the Federal Aviation Administration to revise its regulations regarding pilots and other aviation workers who disclose mental health diagnoses or conditions, aiming to make it easier for these individuals to continue working in their roles while maintaining aviation safety standards.
